prompt:
Create ONE finished tarot illustration, portrait 2:3 (1024x1536), edge-to-edge full bleed. Use the first reference images strictly for the ACTUAL Dragon Quest character identities, hairstyles, faces and costume colors. Some official references contain sepia portraits, page text, frames or UI: use only the solid colored character design, never reproduce reference text/layout. The LAST reference is an already accepted DQIII Fool card used ONLY for matching the deck's bold clean black linework, classic Toriyama Dragon Quest cel coloring, subtly hand-painted paper texture, warm ivory highlights, rich clear blue/turquoise atmosphere, greens and warm ochre accents; do NOT reuse its hero or composition. Actual named characters, not generic original adventurers. Large legible silhouettes and faces; scene thoughtfully composed for a phone screen. Character identity and correct suit-object count matter more than elaborate detail.
Character reference 1: DQ XI Luminary: straight shoulder-length chestnut bob parted at center, long PURPLE leather coat with brass fasteners over dark sleeves, brown trousers, green tall boots, diagonal beige leather strap and small beige satchel. Preserve actual official youthful face and costume.
Tarot composition: The World. The actual DQXI Luminary stands confidently in the center of a large complete oval laurel wreath made of green leaves and little golden flowers. His purple coat, chestnut bob and green boots remain faithful, arms relaxed and open in satisfaction. Behind him the panorama unites green hills, a coastal village, mountain path and distant castle, a complete journey under a warm blue sky. His sword is sheathed. Completion and belonging, no text or crest labels.
One coherent illustration, no collage. Absolutely no card title, text, numbers, letters, UI, logo, watermark, outer border/frame or photographed card. Do not add extra weapons or suit objects. Objects explicitly counted must all be visibly separate and accurately counted, with no duplicates or obscured extras. Preserve official costume and clear anatomy.
visual_review: Visually reviewed: correct recognizable character, coherent tarot scene, no card title/frame and correct suit count where applicable.
